name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-bygga
description: Bygga by Hassan & Youssef: step-by-step assembly guides in 3D for 1,171 IKEA products, with every part, screw and tool, read out loud in English. An independent project, not affiliated with IKEA.

descriptionI18n.en: Bygga by Hassan & Youssef: step-by-step assembly guides in 3D for 1,171 IKEA products, with every part, screw and tool, read out loud in English. An independent project, not affiliated with IKEA.
descriptionI18n.fr: Bygga, par Hassan et Youssef : le montage pas à pas en 3D de 1 171 produits IKEA, avec chaque pièce, vis et outil, lu à voix haute en anglais. Un projet indépendant, sans lien avec IKEA.
descriptionI18n.es: Bygga, de Hassan y Youssef: el montaje paso a paso en 3D de 1171 productos de IKEA, con cada pieza, tornillo y herramienta, leído en voz alta en inglés. Un proyecto independiente, sin relación con IKEA.

agentGuide: Bygga shows furniture assembly guides in 3D, one step at a time, for 1,171 IKEA products.

open takes the product's IKEA name, with its size or kind in English when the person said one (« KALLAX 2x2 », « BILLY 80x202 », « MALM bed »). What opens carries the name that was said: a match under another name is refused with close names; pick one and call again.

next, back and again work only while a step is on screen. Before the steps (cover, tools, parts) the person presses Start building, or open is called again with step 1. After the last step the build is finished.
open with step goes straight to that step, skipping the cover, tools and parts, as the site's ?step= link does.
again plays the step's 3D animation again. It does not repeat the voice.
While help, the overview or a dialog is open over the guide, next, back and again are refused: the person closes it first.
Read status before saying that a step changed.

agentActions.summary: Read what Bygga shows: the screen, and in a guide the product, the phase (before-steps, steps, built) and the step on screen.
Open the assembly guide of a product, as the search box does, on its cover or straight on a step.

product.description: The product as the person says it, e.g. « KALLAX 2x2 » or « BILLY ».

step.description: Open the guide on this step (1 = the first). A step past the last one opens the last.

agentActions.summary: Go to the next step of the guide on screen, as the right arrow does.
Go back one step in the guide on screen, as the left arrow does.
Play the 3D animation of the step on screen again, as the R key does.
